title: polypodium unitum
intro: Polypodium unitum, commonly known as California polypody or Western polypody, is a species of fern native to the western coast of North America. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium unitum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
